description_en: Executes a PowerShell or Bat script on one or more cloud computers that run the Windows operating system
description_zh: 在一台或多台Windows操作系统的云电脑中执行一段PowerShell或者Bat类型的脚本
kebab_example: aliyun ecd run-command --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type RunPowerShellScript --command-content ipconfig --desktop-id ecd-7w78ozhjcwa3u0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCommand

parameters.help_en: The language type of the O&M script
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The plaintext or Base64-encoded content of the script. The Base64-encoded script content cannot exceed 16 KB.

If the script content is Base64-encoded, set the ContentEncoding parameter to Base64
parameters.help_zh:
脚本的明文内容或者Base64编码后的内容。  
脚本内容Base64编码后不能超过16 KB。

若为Base64编码后的脚本内容，则参数ContentEncoding必须配置为Base64
parameters.name: command_content

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for executing the script. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300. A timeout may occur when the script cannot run due to process issues, missing modules, or missing Cloud Assistant Agent. After a timeout, the script process is forcefully terminated
parameters.help_zh:
执行脚本的超时时间，单位为秒。默认值：300。  
当因为进程原因、缺失模块、缺失云助手客户端等原因无法运行脚本时，会出现超时现象。超时后，会强制终止脚本进程
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
The encoding method of the script content.

If the specified value is not within the valid values, the value is treated as PlainText
parameters.help_zh:
脚本内容的编码方式。

若传入的值不在枚举值范围内，则一律作为传入`PlainText`处理
parameters.name: content_encoding

parameters.help_en: The IDs of cloud computers. Valid values of N: 1 to 50. If you specify multiple cloud computers, the API call succeeds as long as the script is successfully executed on at least one cloud computer. If the script fails to be executed on all specified cloud computers, reset this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
云电脑ID列表。N的取值范围：1\~50。  
如果指定了多台云电脑，只要有一台云电脑可以成功执行脚本，该API就能调用成功。当指定的多台云电脑均无法执行脚本时，您需要重新设置该参数
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the end user. If this parameter is specified, the command is executed with the permissions of the end user.

The user must have a session record on the cloud computer (the user has logged on and connected to the cloud computer after it is started, and the connection was not preempted by another user). This parameter is not supported for Linux cloud computers
parameters.help_zh:
终端用户的ID，若此参数不为空，则会以终端用户的权限执行命令。

该用户需要在云电脑上存在会话记录（云电脑开机后有过登录及连接行为，且连接时未被其他用户抢占）。Linux云电脑不支持该参数
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The role used when the command is executed on the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 命令在云电脑内执行时使用的角色
parameters.name: command_role

InvokeId.description_en: The script execution ID. You can call [DescribeInvocations](~~DescribeInvocations~~) and pass in this value to query the script execution status
InvokeId.description_zh: 脚本执行ID。可以调用[DescribeInvocations](~~DescribeInvocations~~)并传入该值来查询脚本执行状态
